violation: Drain pipe slope less than 1/4" per foot horizontal
fix: Re-pipe or adjust grade to achieve minimum slope. 1/4" per foot (2%) for pipes 3" and under; 1/8" per foot (1%) for pipes 4" and over.

violation: Building drain or building sewer slope less than 1/16" per foot
fix: Relay pipe to achieve minimum 1/16" per foot (0.625%) slope for building drains and sewers 6" and larger.

violation: Vent terminal not extending through the roof at least 6"
fix: Extend vent terminal to extend through the roof at least 6 inches above the roof surface.

violation: Vent pipe less than 1 1/4" diameter for revent
fix: Replace revent pipe with minimum 1 1/4" diameter pipe.

violation: Trap seal less than 2" for floor drains
fix: Install deep-seal trap or increase trap seal depth to minimum 2".

violation: Cleanout not provided at required intervals (max 100 ft horizontal)
fix: Install cleanouts at required intervals. Maximum 100 feet between cleanouts on horizontal pipe.

violation: Fixture unit count exceeds pipe sizing table for pipe diameter
fix: Up-size the building drain or building sewer per Table 610.1 based on total fixture unit load.
Install a properly sized T&P relief valve on the water heater.

violation: Backflow preventer not installed on potable water supply connection
fix: Install appropriate backflow prevention assembly at the cross-connection point.

violation: Air gap not provided at required locations
fix: Install air gap separation with minimum 1" gap above flood level rim.

violation: Individual water supply not meeting code requirements
fix: Bring individual water supply into compliance with applicable codes or connect to public supply.

violation: No-hub coupling without proper clamp installation
fix: Re-install no-hub coupling with stainless steel shield and worm gear clamps per manufacturer's instructions.

violation: Developed length of trap arm exceeds code maximum
fix: Relocate fixture closer to the trap or install a separate vent. Maximum trap arm length varies by pipe diameter.

violation: Cleanout access not properly provided
fix: Provide cleanout fitting or access door meeting code requirements.

violation: Sump pit not properly sized or sealed
fix: Install sump pit per code: minimum 18" diameter, sealed cover, and ejector pump appropriately sized.

severity: Industrial wastes not pre-treated before drainage connection
fix: Install grease interceptor, oil-water separator, or other pre-treatment device.

violation: Chemical waste not neutralized before drainage connection
fix: Install acid neutralizing basin with proper neutralization materials before drainage connection.

violation: Fixtures not spaced per code minimums
fix: Relocate fixtures to meet minimum clearances per code tables.

violation: Bathtub or shower not properly waterproofed
fix: Install shower pan liner or waterproof membrane per code requirements.

violation: Shower door not meeting safety glazing requirements
fix: Replace shower door with safety glazing meeting ASTM C1036 requirements.

violation: Drain slope less than 1/4" per foot for 3" and under pipe
fix: Re-grade drain to minimum 1/4" per foot slope.

violation: Horizontal drainage pipe slope less than 1/8" per foot for 4" and over
fix: Re-grade pipe to minimum 1/8" per foot slope for 4" and larger pipe.

violation: Vent not meeting minimum opening height requirement
fix: Extend vent to extend through the roof at least 6" above the roof surface.

violation: Relief vent not provided for certain installations
fix: Install relief vent per code requirements for multi-story or long branch applications.

violation: Trap seal depth less than code minimum for floor drains
fix: Install deep-seal trap or adjust to meet minimum seal depth requirements.

violation: Cleanout spacing exceeds code maximum (100 ft horizontal)
fix: Install additional cleanouts to meet the 100-foot maximum spacing requirement.

violation: Building drain sized below fixture unit load requirements
fix: Re-size building drain per UPC Table 610.1 based on total DFU load.

severity: T&P relief valve not properly installed or sized
fix: Install T&P relief valve with correct size, rating, and discharge piping.

violation: Backflow assembly not tested or approved
fix: Install approved backflow prevention assembly and schedule annual testing.

violation: Air gap less than 1" above flood level rim
fix: Increase air gap to minimum 1" above the flood level rim of the receptor.

violation: Threaded connection not meeting code requirements
fix: Re-thread with proper schedule and use compatible thread sealant.

violation: Backwater valve not installed where required
fix: Install backwater valve at the junction of building drain and building sewer.

violation: Fixture carrier not properly rated or installed
fix: Install properly rated fixture carrier per manufacturer's instructions and code.

severity: Food waste disposer not meeting code requirements
fix: Verify disposer meets code requirements; install if missing.

violation: Shower stall dimensions below minimum
fix: Provide shower stall meeting minimum dimensions: minimum 900 sq. in. floor area.

violation: Water closet not meeting required flush volume
fix: Replace water closet with a fixture rated for maximum 1.28 GPF (or per local requirement).

violation: Hot water temperature below 110°F at lavatory
fix: Adjust water heater temperature or install tempering valve to maintain minimum 110°F at lavatory.

violation: Fixture not properly supported or anchored
fix: Provide proper fixture support per code requirements for wall-hung fixtures.

violation: Faucet not meeting maximum flow rate requirements
fix: Replace faucet with model meeting maximum 2.2 GPM at 60 PSI (or local requirement).

violation: Expansion tank not installed on closed water system
fix: Install expansion tank to handle thermal expansion in closed system.

violation: Hot water recirculation line not properly insulated
fix: Insulate hot water recirculation piping per code.

violation: Bidet installation not meeting code
fix: Verify bidet meets all code requirements including hot/cold supply and drainage.

violation: Drinking fountain not meeting water efficiency requirements
fix: Replace with drinking fountain meeting required GPM and filtration standards.

violation: Dishwashing machine air gap not provided
fix: Install air gap fitting on the counter for the dishwasher drain connection.

violation: Laundry tub not properly installed with required air gap
fix: Provide minimum 1" air gap between laundry tub flood level and hose connection.

violation: Hose bibb not equipped with backflow preventer
fix: Install hose bibb with integral vacuum breaker or replace with approved backflow-protected fixture.

violation: Water supply not properly connected to listed components
fix: Connect water supply using approved methods per the component listing.

violity: Water heater relief valve discharge piping undersized
fix: Size relief valve discharge pipe per code: minimum 3/4" diameter, no shut-off valve, terminate within 6" of floor.

violation: Water heater not properly braced for seismic activity
fix: Install seismic bracing per ASCE 7-05 requirements for the geographic zone.

violation: Sump pit drain not properly sized
fix: Size sump pit drain per code requirements for the ejector pump capacity.

violation: Drain line not properly pitched
fix: Adjust pitch to meet minimum requirements for the pipe diameter.

violation: Reduced pressure principle backflow preventer not tested annually
fix: Schedule annual backflow assembly test by certified tester.
